title: Peptide Family Promotes Brain Cell Rejuvenation and Improved Cognition through Peripheral Delivery.
authors: Anton-Fernandez, Alejandro; Domene-Serrano, Indalo; Cuadros, Raquel; Peinado-Cahuchola, Rocio; Sanchez-Pece, Margarita; Hernandez, Felix; Avila, Jesus
one_liner_zh: 该文研究靶向叶酸受体α的肽配体促进脑细胞年轻化，虽涉及受体-肽结合和核内转录因子功能，但核心是肽-蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI/物理模拟方法用于结合建模，仅用AlphaFold建模，与本课题关联度低。
abstract: Ligands targeting folate receptor alpha (FRalpha), a protein predominantly expressed in neural cells, have the potential to reprogram (rejuvenate) brain cells and enhance cognitive function in aged mice. In this study, we present a family of FRalpha-binding peptides identified through AlphaFold modeling. These peptides induce a structural change in the receptor upon binding, which facilitates its internalization and transport to the cell nucleus. Once in the nucleus, FRalpha functions as a transcription factor, promoting the expression of genes associated with a youthful phenotype and improved cognition. Notably, these peptides demonstrate permeability across the blood-brain barrier, enabling their administration not only through intracranial injection but also via peripheral delivery methods such as intraperitoneal injection or gastric gavage. This property enhances their potential for use in future therapeutic applications.
abstract_zh: 靶向叶酸受体α（FRalpha）的配体，该受体是一种在神经细胞中主要表达的蛋白质，具有重编程（恢复活力）脑细胞并增强老年小鼠认知功能的潜力。在本研究中，我们通过AlphaFold建模鉴定出一系列FRalpha结合肽。这些肽在结合时诱导受体发生结构变化，从而促进其内化并转运至细胞核。一旦进入细胞核，FRalpha作为转录因子发挥作用，促进与年轻表型和改善认知相关的基因表达。值得注意的是，这些肽表现出穿越血脑屏障的渗透性，使其不仅可通过颅内注射给药，还可通过外周递送方式如腹腔注射或胃管灌胃给药。这一特性增强了其在未来治疗应用中的潜力。
